name: What is clash detection, and how does AI improve it?

mainEntity.name: What is clash detection, and how does AI improve it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clash detection identifies where building elements (pipes, ducts, beams) intersect impossibly; AI scans BIM models in real-time, predicts conflicts, and suggests resolutions automatically. autodesk​
